# [v70_mchain] Chain follow-ups consolidated into direct event chains.
# Project Phoenix v50.0 — Hellenism & Religio Romana Deep Overhaul (Main Mod Layer 1, oe_v50_romp_). Generated by gen_v500_hellenism_deep_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.

yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_v50_romp_yearly_pulse
	}
}

oe_v50_romp_yearly_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
	}
	effect = {
		religion:hellenism_religion = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = hellenism_has_omens } }
				set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_cd }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_ev_501_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_ev_501_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.501
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_ev_505_done }
					owns = location:rome
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_ev_505_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.505
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_ev_506_done }
					OR = { owns = location:thessaloniki owns = location:larissa }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_ev_506_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.506
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_ev_509_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_ev_509_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.509
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_ev_511_done }
					has_ports = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_ev_511_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.511
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_ev_513_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_ev_513_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.513
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_ev_517_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_ev_517_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.517
			}
		}
	}
}
